title: Selective model-weight replacement
question: Can a selected model capability be represented and served by AIR with held-out quality preserved and lower lifecycle-inclusive cost, with original model weights absent for AIR-only inference?
systems: AIR-only converted capability package with teacher and neural fallback unloaded
hybrid AIR-first routing with all model fallbacks logged
optional reference-fed AIR oracle ceiling, reported separately
required_reporting: AIR direct-answer coverage and hybrid fallback rate
cold and warm latency, throughput, and end-to-end wall time
whole-system peak RAM and documented energy meter boundary
conversion time and energy, lifecycle-inclusive cost, and break-even query volume
raw prompts, outputs, errors, identities, hashes, and fallback decisions

pass_claims.air_replaces_selected_capability: AIR-only passes every AIR-only quality and resource threshold with the original model unloaded.
pass_claims.hybrid_reduces_cost: Hybrid stays within the quality tolerance and lowers measured lifecycle-adjusted resource cost; this is selective routing, not weight replacement.

limitations: Passing a factual retrieval gate does not establish replacement of general-purpose model weights.
The current G01 harness lacks hybrid fallback comparison and target-laptop whole-system energy measurement.
Same-author development results are not acceptance evidence.
